# @dxtmisha/styles

> SCSS design system tokens, dynamic CSS variable engine (`--sys-*`), and responsive mixins for DXT UI.

Provides the visual source of truth for all `@dxtmisha` packages, decoupling color channels and opacity for dynamic theming, fluid typography, and flexbox orchestration.

## SCSS Modules & Mixins

- [src/styles/index.scss](src/styles/index.scss): Main entry point importing all SCSS mixins and utilities.
- [src/styles/properties/index.scss](src/styles/properties/index.scss): Dynamic CSS custom properties generator engine.
- [colors-layout.md](ai-resources/colors-layout.md): Guidelines for color mixins (`backgroundColor`, `paletteBackgroundColor`), borders, and spacing.
- [media-typography.md](ai-resources/media-typography.md): Responsive media mixins (`mediaMinWidth`), typography styles (`font`), and BEM naming rules.

## Optional & AI Resources

- [ai-description.md](ai-description.md): Technical architecture and SCSS property pipeline.
- [README.md](README.md): Installation and quick start SCSS examples.
